result.title: NIR: Approximate Neural Instance Retrieval for ALCIQ
result.summary: Instance retrieval is the main bottleneck of concept-learning systems based on refinement operators. We present NIR, a family of neural instance retrievers for ALCIQ that output graded membership scores from knowledge graph embeddings. We compare tokenization-based encoders (GRU, LSTM, Transformer) with a Compositional encoder that mirrors DL operators via primitive sub-networks. On eight benchmarks, all variants approximate Pellet closely on complete knowledge bases, while the Transformer model is most robust under incompleteness. The source code of our approach is at https://github.com/dice-group/owlapy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NIR，用知识图谱嵌入训练面向 ALCIQ 的神经实例检索器以输出分级隶属度，替代 Pellet 等符号推理器，并在八个基准上比较 GRU、LSTM、Transformer 与按 DL 算子结构化的组合式编码器，考察完整与不完备知识库下的近似效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其组合式编码器把 DL 算子拆成原始子网络，可能为「内部状态是否保留组合与算子结构」以及神经近似符号推理的失败模式提供可核查线索，但对象是本体实例检索而非视觉多模态推理，迁移价值需进一步判断。
